description: Evaluate a payment intent. MUST be called before executing any payment. ALLOW = you may pay; DENY = you must abandon; ASK = a challenge is returned — relay the reason to the user, then retry with approval_token once the user signs. An optional mandate parameter carries a user-issued single-task authorization.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier for agent-scoped policy or attribution
agent_id.title: Agent Id

amount.description: Payment amount in USDC or the policy's accounting unit
amount.title: Amount

approval_token.description: Wallet-signed approval token for the exact ASK challenge and payment intent
approval_token.title: Approval Token

asset.description: Payment asset identifier or contract address
asset.title: Asset

expected_amount.description: Caller-accepted price; deterministic checks reject a different declared amount
expected_amount.title: Expected Amount

expected_recipient.description: Caller-approved payee; deterministic checks reject substitution
expected_recipient.title: Expected Recipient

mandate.description: Optional user-issued single-task payment mandate object
mandate.title: Mandate

method.description: HTTP method of the paid resource, such as GET or POST
method.title: Method

network.description: CAIP-2 payment network, for example eip155:8453
network.title: Network

owner.description: Owner wallet address; required for a persistent hosted budget reservation
owner.title: Owner

purchase_id.description: Caller-generated ID for one logical purchase; concurrent duplicates cannot obtain a second ALLOW
purchase_id.title: Purchase Id

recipient.description: Payee address, host or recipient identifier to evaluate
recipient.title: Recipient

resource.description: Resource URL or host/path used for per-endpoint budgets
resource.title: Resource

source_content.description: Merchant content that triggered payment; semantic evaluation scans it for injection and drift
source_content.title: Source Content

name: evaluate_payment
